statement.label: Our approach
statement.text: Every case deserves to be heard first. We don't draw up a plan before we understand your situation, and we explain the options and risks in plain words.

services.label: Practice Areas
services.title: Where we can help
services.intro: From disputes that arise in everyday life to companies' contract and compliance needs, we advise and represent clients across a wide range of matters. The list below is a starting point; if your topic isn't on it, feel free to ask.
services.noteLink: Tell us briefly and we'll take a look.

commercial.title: Commercial & Corporate Law
commercial.description: Company formation, shareholder and general assembly matters, commercial contracts and representation in commercial disputes.

contracts.title: Contract Law
contracts.description: Drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts, and identifying legal risks in advance.

labor.title: Employment Law
labor.description: Employer–employee disputes, severance and notice pay, reinstatement claims and employment contracts.

family.title: Family & Divorce Law
family.description: Uncontested and contested divorce, custody, alimony, division of property and other family law matters.

criminal.title: Criminal Law
criminal.description: Representation of suspects, defendants, victims and intervening parties during investigation and trial.

realEstate.title: Real Estate & Tenancy Law
realEstate.description: Title deed cancellation and registration, rent determination and eviction cases, condominium matters and property transactions.

inheritance.title: Inheritance Law
inheritance.description: Certificates of inheritance, wills, reduction and simulated transaction claims, and division of the estate.

enforcement.title: Enforcement & Bankruptcy Law
enforcement.description: Debt collection, enforcement proceedings, annulment of objection, negative declaratory actions and bankruptcy.

administrative.title: Administrative Law
administrative.description: Annulment and full remedy actions against administrative acts, administrative applications and public procurement.

sports.title: Sports Law
sports.description: Transfer, sponsorship and representation agreements for athletes, clubs and agents, and federation disputes.

energy.title: Energy Law
energy.description: Advisory services on energy projects, licensing procedures, regulatory compliance and sector-specific agreements.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection (KVKK)
dataProtection.description: Compliance with personal data protection legislation, privacy notices and data processing policies.

about.label: About
about.title: A small practice, direct communication.
about.p1: Aydın Law & Consulting was founded in Ankara by Attorney İrem Aydın. Your case is handled directly by your attorney, so you always know who to reach.
about.p2: A graduate of TOBB University of Economics and Technology Faculty of Law, İrem Aydın completed a master's in sports management and legal skills at ISDE Law Business School (FC Barcelona). She has worked on national and international projects in commercial, contract, sports and energy law.
about.p3: Today the practice supports individuals in family, employment, real estate, inheritance and criminal matters, and companies with contracts, commercial law and compliance.

approach.label: How We Work
approach.title: How does a case move forward?
approach.intro: It helps to know what to expect from the first call to the outcome. The process usually follows four steps.

1.title: First contact
1.description: Reach us by phone, WhatsApp or email; a few sentences about your matter is enough.

2.title: Initial meeting
2.description: We listen to your situation in detail and go through your documents together.

3.title: Assessment
3.description: We set out the options, the risks and the likely timeline clearly.

4.title: Follow-through
4.description: Once litigation or advisory work begins, we update you on every significant development.

1.title: Confidentiality
1.description: Everything you share is protected by the rules of the legal profession and attorney–client privilege.

2.title: Clarity
2.description: We don't hide behind legal jargon; we explain what is happening and what could happen in plain words.

3.title: Availability
3.description: You can always ask where your case stands and get a straight answer.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let's arrange a conversation.
contact.text: Describe your matter briefly and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. For urgent matters, call us directly.
contact.note: All communications are handled in accordance with confidentiality principles and the rules of the legal profession.
